draft.subject: Photographing Solaris Quartet at Carnegie Hall.
draft.body: I'm Dan Wright, a performing arts photographer based in New York City. I'm writing in regard to the Solaris Quartet's April 2 date at Carnegie Hall. I've been photographing at Carnegie Hall for close to ten years, and I work without flash and stay out of the way, so nobody watching registers that I'm there. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one hour minimum, and I deliver the edited gallery inside two weeks. There's more of my work at danwrightphotography.com. I'd be glad to hear where your photography plans for that evening stand. I look forward to your reply.
